conventions.dates: All explicitly timed boundaries below are UTC instants, not inferred midnights for date-only prose.
conventions.acceptance: Later information is usable only after its explicit acceptance; arrival alone does not settle competing reports.
conventions.unknown: No stated time means no temporal applicability answer, not forever and not ingestion time.

inputs: Calculation C used the original reported price at an identified knowledge position and domain time.
A correction for that same domain time is subsequently accepted.
A separate hypothetical calculation happens to have the corrected numerical result.

compare C premises to corrected selection
result under corrected premises before execution
